scripts.test: node scripts/native-cargo.mjs test --locked -p monocode-core --profile native-dev && node scripts/native-cargo.mjs test --locked -p monocode-gpui --profile native-dev -- --test-threads=1
scripts.test:scripts: node --test scripts/dev-native.test.mjs scripts/bundle-native-macos.test.mjs scripts/native-dependencies.test.mjs scripts/native-release.test.mjs scripts/package-native.test.mjs scripts/native-sherpa.test.mjs
scripts.check: bun run test:scripts && cargo fmt --all --check && node scripts/native-cargo.mjs clippy --locked -p monocode-core -p monocode-gpui --all-targets --profile native-dev -- -D warnings
